deploy.command: cd contrib/block-box && make base && make lvm && docker-compose up -d
deploy.verify: cd contrib/block-box && docker-compose ps (all services Up); a volume list against the noauth endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8776/v3 succeeds with OS_AUTH_TYPE=noauth, CINDER_ENDPOINT, OS_PROJECT_ID and OS_USERNAME
deploy.rollback: No rollback or version-restore command is defined in the repository; see gaps
gaps: No dedicated test-environment target, owner, or authorization boundary is defined; contrib/block-box is a containerized development example, not a configured test environment
No secure credential source: docker-compose.yml and docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/script.sql use hard-coded sample passwords, and cinder.rc uses sample noauth values
No rollback or version-restore procedure/command is documented, and no effective-version check is defined
The base-image build depends on the loci-cinder source at git.openstack.org, which may be unavailable; no acceptance criteria are defined for deployment readiness

it.command: tox -e all-plugin -- volume (run from a Tempest checkout with the in-tree Cinder plugin installed)
it.success_criteria: All selected Tempest volume plugin tests pass with zero failures and zero errors; empty or all-skipped runs are not a pass; assertion failures, environment errors, and execution errors are distinguished and recorded with command, code version, test identifiers, output, and conclusion
gaps: No configured target environment: Tempest must run from an external checkout against a devstack deployment with Cinder enabled; no such environment or endpoint is defined in this repository
No secure credential acquisition method: the only auth example is a hard-coded local.conf sample (ADMIN_PASSWORD=secret) in cinder/tests/tempest/README.rst
No pinned Cinder/Tempest/devstack versions and no repository-defined aggregate IT gate thresholds beyond a successful test run
